description: Baza reguł FuzzyBrain. Wejścia liczone z Observation, wyjścia to opłacalność zachowań (0..1). Zbiory: 3 punkty = trójkąt, 4 punkty = trapez.
rules: IF visible IS yes AND ammo IS high AND hp IS high THEN attack IS high
IF visible IS yes AND distance IS medium AND ammo IS NOT none THEN attack IS high
IF visible IS yes AND opponent_hp IS low AND ammo IS NOT none THEN attack IS high
IF visible IS yes AND ammo IS low AND hp IS NOT low THEN attack IS medium
IF visible IS yes AND distance IS far AND opponent_speed IS fast THEN attack IS low
IF visible IS no AND ammo IS NOT none AND hp IS NOT low THEN attack IS medium
IF ammo IS none THEN attack IS low
IF threat IS high THEN attack IS low
IF hp IS low AND visible IS yes THEN cover IS high
IF hp IS low AND distance IS near THEN cover IS high
IF ammo IS none AND visible IS yes AND pickup_distance IS far THEN cover IS high
IF visible IS yes AND hp IS medium AND opponent_hp IS high THEN cover IS medium
IF visible IS no AND hp IS low THEN cover IS medium
IF hp IS high AND ammo IS high THEN cover IS low
IF threat IS high THEN dodge IS high
IF threat IS medium AND distance IS near THEN dodge IS high
IF threat IS medium AND hp IS NOT high THEN dodge IS medium
IF threat IS low THEN dodge IS low
IF ammo IS none THEN collect IS high
IF ammo IS low AND pickup_distance IS near THEN collect IS high
IF ammo IS low AND visible IS no THEN collect IS medium
IF ammo IS high THEN collect IS low
IF ammo IS low AND visible IS yes AND hp IS high THEN collect IS low
IF threat IS high THEN collect IS low
IF visible IS yes AND impact_energy IS low THEN attack IS low
IF visible IS yes AND impact_energy IS high AND ammo IS NOT none THEN attack IS high
IF hp IS low AND medkit_distance IS near THEN heal IS high
IF hp IS low AND visible IS no THEN heal IS high
IF hp IS medium AND medkit_distance IS near AND visible IS no THEN heal IS medium
IF hp IS high THEN heal IS low
IF threat IS high THEN heal IS low
IF hp IS low AND visible IS yes AND medkit_distance IS far THEN heal IS low
IF visible IS yes AND distance IS near AND aim_error IS large THEN cover IS high
IF visible IS yes AND distance IS near AND aim_error IS large THEN attack IS low
IF visible IS yes AND aim_error IS small AND ammo IS NOT none AND impact_energy IS high THEN attack IS high
IF self_speed IS fast AND threat IS medium THEN dodge IS low
